decisions.reason: The planned training video and personal-brand education do not change the existing requirement to select strong source moments.
The lead-role training and team structure do not change the trial qualification method, criteria, clip count, or deadline.
The source does not specify any change to caption color or other caption styling.
The source does not alter or supersede the required 30-to-90-second clip duration.
Learning the personal brand pillars and exact creation method does not change which content sources are permitted.
The planned training may explain the team's method but does not explicitly change the existing clean-editing standard.
The source changes lead-role training and team structure, not the channel or content used to submit sample clips for review.
